description: This Java class 'PdfSurveyServices' provides methods for creating, reading, and manipulating PDF-based surveys within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for building surveys from PDFs, extracting and setting form fields, generating survey response PDFs, and managing survey questions and answers.

classes.name: PdfSurveyServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for handling PDF-based surveys, including creation, extraction, and response processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildSurveyFromPdf
methods.description: Creates a survey in the system from a PDF form, extracting questions and storing them as survey questions.

methods.name: buildSurveyResponseFromPdf
methods.description: Builds a survey response in the system from a filled PDF form.

methods.name: getAcroFieldsFromPdf
methods.description: Extracts form fields and their values from a PDF.

methods.name: setAcroFields
methods.description: Sets form field values in a PDF based on provided data.

methods.name: buildPdfFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Generates a PDF document representing a survey response.

methods.name: buildSurveyQuestionsAndAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves survey questions and answers as a list of question-answer pairs.

methods.name: setAcroFieldsFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Populates PDF form fields with answers from a survey response.

methods.name: getInputByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the input PDF as a ByteBuffer from either a file or content resource.
